author: The Critical Drinker
description:
As Hollywood desperately copes and even blames the fans for the disaster of Starfleet Academy, we have a good laugh at them, while taking a look at A Knight Of The Seven Kingdoms, the trailer for Masters of the Universe, and the first look at Henry Cavill in the new Highlander reboot.
